document.abstract: When I was asked to talk about Home Utilization of Cassettes, I told However, we also have in the home several tests of cassette your Chairman that we had cassettes in use in the home today. We do – exactly six! However, we also have in the home several tests of cassette programing on videotape recorders and other technical devices that will be transferred to cassettes – some next week and more every week thereafter – until we are in several hundred homes by the end of next year.

authors.bio: Paul J. Caravatt, Jr., has just formed a company, Newtel Communications, Inc., 575 Lexington Ave., New York, NY 10022. Previously, he was Senior Vice-president and a Director of the Interpublic Group of Companies. He also held the position of Chairman of the Board of Marschalk (part of the Interpublic Group). Mr. Caravatt's career has taken him through many positions in various advertising agencies. Since 1970 he has been involved solely with video cassettes.
